findings.detail: CORRECTION 2026-08-16 ON THE BEEF FAT CLASS NOTE VERIFIED ARITHMETICALLY RIGHT, FIGURE BY FIGURE: build-vs-mapper offset 26.7 (538.2 - 511.5 = 26.7, exact); post-rebase 80/20 build basis 524 was 538.2 (538.2 - 14.1 = 524.1, and my independent recompute of current bytes lands 524.10, matching stat 524 exactly); the 14.1 rebase delta is itself consistent (1/3-fat row contributes 35.4 cal/serving from 198 g at 70 cal/28 g, so the prior full-fat row computes to ~98 cal/28 g, which is the USDA full-fat figure); 93/7 near 380 on the mapper basis (394.6 - 14.1 = 380.5); near 407 on the build basis - and I confirmed this by DIRECT computation with the actual carried 93/7 Ground Beef row (Member's Mark, 170 cal/113 g): swapping 1588 g of beef gives 406.64 cal/serving on the build basis, which CLEARS the 400 floor by ~6.6 cal. So the correction's direction is right: on the build basis lean beef clears, on the mapper basis it misses, and calling the lean-beef question OPEN and basis-dependent is the honest statement, especially at a ~7 cal margin. The shipped card (80/20, 524) is unaffected. No stale figure survives uncorrected: the MACROS note's pre-rebase 538.2/31.1/5.3/42.3 sits under its own dated RESOLVED sentence directing readers to the stat block, and the remaining four writer_notes (scale provenance, step walk, shop_smart, substitutions) were re-walked against current bytes and assert nothing false - the step-number map in the ingredient-use note matches make_it exactly.

CREAM-CHEESE DIVERGENCE RE-RULED ON CURRENT BYTES (not inherited) AND IT HOLDS: live page re-fetched 2026-08-16 and matches the extraction line for line (4 servings, 12 lines); source calls for 2 oz regular cream cheese, card ships 1/3 Fat Cream Cheese (Great Value) 7 oz / 198 g = exact 3.5x, bid 1-3-fat-cream-cheese, per Brad's dated 2026-08-16 ruling recorded in writer_notes. Disclosed everywhere a reader looks: ingredients_display, head.recipeIngredient, cost_lines, and the shop_smart bullet ('eight ounce brick of 1/3 less fat cream cheese'). CHEDDAR legitimately stays full-fat and only the cream cheese moved: the shop_smart bullet still instructs 'real full-fat cheddar rather than the low-fat kind', and the macros are computed on the full-fat shredded cheddar row (110 cal/28 g), which my recompute used.
